question: What is the atomic number of Bohrium which is named after physicist Niels Bohr, one of the founders of quantum theory?
solution:
The correct answer is __**107.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bohrium** is a synthetic chemical element with the symbol **Bh** and atomic number **107.**
 
• It was first synthesized in **1981** by a team of **Soviet and German** scientists.
 
• Bohrium is a **highly radioactive element** that does not occur
